vocabulary.meaning_en: quick, cheap food you order at a counter, like burgers and fries
vocabulary.example: We had fast food because we were in a hurry.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a relaxed restaurant where you sit at a table and can wear normal clothes
vocabulary.example: Casual dining is good for families.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an expensive, formal restaurant with very good service
vocabulary.note_ar: fine هنا تعني راقٍ وغالي الثمن
vocabulary.note_en: Here "fine" means high quality and expensive.
vocabulary.example: Fine dining usually needs a reservation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an arrangement to keep a table for you at a certain time
vocabulary.example: I'd like to make a reservation for Friday evening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a restaurant: a group of people who eat together
vocabulary.note_ar: في المطعم لا تعني حفلة بل عدد أفراد المجموعة
vocabulary.note_en: In a restaurant it does not mean a celebration; it means your group.
vocabulary.example: How many are in your party?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a list of the food and drinks a restaurant serves
vocabulary.example: Could we see the menu, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the drinks you ask the waiter to bring
vocabulary.example: The waiter took our drink order first.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small dish you eat first, before the main meal
vocabulary.note_ar: يأتي أولًا ويكون صغيرًا، مثل الشوربة أو السلطة
vocabulary.note_en: It comes first and is small, e.g. soup or salad.
vocabulary.example: We ordered soup as an appetizer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: another word for appetizer: the first small dish
vocabulary.example: Would you like a starter?

vocabulary.meaning_en: dishes the restaurant offers today, often at a better price
vocabulary.note_ar: special of the day = طبق اليوم
vocabulary.example: What are today's specials?

vocabulary.meaning_en: fresh fish caught today and served today
vocabulary.note_en: catch = what fishermen get from the sea
vocabulary.example: The catch of the day is grilled fish with lemon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the soup the restaurant makes today; it changes every day
vocabulary.example: The soup of the day is lentil soup.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a meal of several courses for one fixed price
vocabulary.note_ar: كلمة فرنسية تعني سعرًا ثابتًا، وتُنطق /ˌpriː ˈfiːks/
vocabulary.example: The prix fixe includes a starter, a main course and dessert.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in fast food: a meal, fries and a drink together for one price
vocabulary.example: I'll have the number one combo, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the biggest dish of the meal, e.g. chicken and rice
vocabulary.example: For my main course, I'll have the chicken.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to change one thing for another
vocabulary.note_ar: substitute A for B: نضع A بدل B
vocabulary.note_en: substitute A for B = use A instead of B
vocabulary.example: Can I substitute rice for the potatoes?

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra food you order with your main course
vocabulary.note_ar: on the side = إضافةً / بجانب الطبق
vocabulary.note_en: on the side = as an extra
vocabulary.example: I'd like mushrooms on the side.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sweet food you eat at the end of a meal
vocabulary.note_ar: بحرفي s: dessert. أما desert بحرف s واحد فهي الصحراء
vocabulary.note_en: Two s's. desert (one s) = sand and sun.
vocabulary.example: We had chocolate cake for dessert.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the paper that shows how much you must pay
vocabulary.example: Can we have the bill, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: American word for the bill in a restaurant
vocabulary.note_en: UK: cheque is a bank paper, not a restaurant bill.
vocabulary.example: The waiter brought the check after dessert.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money added to the price that goes to the government
vocabulary.example: Is the tax included in the price?

vocabulary.meaning_en: extra money you give the waiter for good service
vocabulary.note_ar: في أمريكا الشمالية عادةً من 10 إلى 20 بالمئة
vocabulary.note_en: In North America usually 10-20 percent. Also a verb: to tip.
vocabulary.example: We left a 15 percent tip.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a man / woman who brings food to tables in a restaurant
vocabulary.example: The waiter was very polite.

vocabulary.meaning_en: jobs where people serve customers, like restaurants and hotels
vocabulary.example: Restaurants are part of the service industry.

fine_lines.title: dessert vs desert
fine_lines.explanation_ar: dessert (بحرفي s) هي الحلوى بعد الطعام. desert (بحرف s واحد) هي الصحراء. تذكّر: الحلوى نريد منها مرتين، لذلك فيها حرفا s.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Dessert (double s) is sweet food after a meal. Desert (one s) is a dry, sandy place. Trick: you want dessert twice, so it has two s's.

examples.sentence: Ice cream is my favourite dessert.
There is a big desert in Saudi Arabia.

fine_lines.title: substitute vs side
fine_lines.explanation_ar: substitute يعني أن تغيّر شيئًا في الطبق بشيء آخر (بطاطا بدل الأرز). side يعني أن تطلب شيئًا إضافيًا لا يأتي مع الطبق، وغالبًا تدفع ثمنه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Substitute = change one thing for another (fries instead of rice). Side = extra food that does not come with the dish; you usually pay for it.

examples.sentence: Can I substitute salad for the fries?
I'll have a side of vegetables too.

fine_lines.title: appetizer vs main course vs dessert
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ترتيب الوجبة: appetizer (طبق صغير أولًا)، ثم main course (الطبق الكبير)، ثم dessert (الحلوى في النهاية).
fine_lines.explanation_en: The order of a meal: appetizer (small, first), then main course (big), then dessert (sweet, last).

examples.sentence: We started with a salad as an appetizer.
Our main course was fish and rice.
We finished with fruit for dessert.

fine_lines.title: bill vs check
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما يعني فاتورة المطعم. bill أكثر استخدامًا في بريطانيا، وcheck في أمريكا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the paper with the price of your meal. Bill is more British; check is American.

examples.sentence: Could we have the bill, please?
Can I get the check, please?

expressions.phrase: Party of two? / Table for four?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل أنتم شخصان؟ / طاولة لأربعة؟ (سؤال عن عدد الأشخاص)
expressions.meaning_en: How many people are in your group?
expressions.example: Good evening. Table for four? - Yes, please.

expressions.meaning_en: How many people are with you?
expressions.example: How many in your party? - There are three of us.
There are two of us, please.

expressions.phrase: Would you like something to drink?
expressions.meaning_en: The waiter asks what you want to drink.
expressions.example: Would you like something to drink? - Water, please.

expressions.phrase: Can I take your drink order?
expressions.meaning_en: May I write down what you want to drink?
expressions.example: Can I take your drink order? - Two orange juices, please.

expressions.phrase: Would you like something to start?
expressions.example: Would you like something to start? - The soup, please.

expressions.meaning_en: to make you hungry and want more
expressions.example: A small salad will whet your appetite.

expressions.phrase: Can I have... / May I have...?
expressions.example: May I have the chicken, please?

expressions.phrase: I'd like to substitute fries for the rice.
expressions.meaning_en: I want fries instead of rice.
expressions.example: Excuse me, I'd like to substitute fries for the rice.

expressions.phrase: Is the tax and tip included?
expressions.meaning_en: Are tax and tip already in the bill?
expressions.example: Is the tax and tip included, or do I add them?
Here is your food. Enjoy your meal!

grammar.title: Polite ordering: Can I have / May I have / I'd like
grammar.explanation_ar: في المطعم لا تقل Give me لأنها تبدو غير مهذبة. استخدم Can I have أو May I have (أكثر تهذيبًا) أو I'd like ثم الاسم، وأضف please.
grammar.explanation_en: Don't say "Give me..."; it sounds rude. Use Can I have..., May I have... (more polite) or I'd like... + noun, and add please.
examples: Can I have a glass of water, please?
May I have the soup of the day?
I'd like the catch of the day, please.

questions.question: What is an appetizer?
choices: A small dish you eat first
The biggest dish of the meal
questions.explanation_en: An appetizer is small and comes first.

questions.question: The waiter asks "Party of two?". What does he want to know?
choices: How many people are in your group
questions.explanation_ar: party في المطعم تعني مجموعة الأشخاص.
questions.explanation_en: In a restaurant, "party" means your group of people.

questions.question: Which word is the sweet food after a meal?
questions.explanation_ar: dessert بحرفي s هي الحلوى، أما desert فهي الصحراء.
questions.explanation_en: Dessert (two s's) is sweet food; desert is a sandy place.

questions.question: I don't want rice. Can I ___ fries for the rice?
questions.explanation_en: Substitute means to change one thing for another.

questions.question: "I'd like mushrooms on the ___." (extra food)
questions.explanation_ar: on the side تعني طعامًا إضافيًا بجانب الطبق.
questions.explanation_en: On the side = extra food with your main course.

questions.question: What is "the catch of the day"?
questions.explanation_ar: catch of the day هو السمك الطازج الذي اصطيد اليوم.
questions.explanation_en: It is fresh fish from today.

questions.question: Which sentence is the most polite way to order?
choices: May I have a burger, please?
questions.explanation_ar: May I have ... please هي الطريقة الأكثر تهذيبًا.
questions.explanation_en: "May I have..., please?" is the most polite.

questions.question: A meal of several courses for one fixed price is called a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: prix fixe كلمة فرنسية تعني سعرًا ثابتًا لعدة أطباق.
questions.explanation_en: Prix fixe is French for "fixed price".

questions.question: In North America, a tip is usually ___ of the bill.
questions.explanation_ar: البقشيش في أمريكا الشمالية عادة من 10 إلى 20 بالمئة.
questions.explanation_en: In North America people usually tip 10 to 20 percent.

questions.question: Which restaurant usually needs a reservation and is expensive?
questions.explanation_ar: fine dining مطاعم فاخرة غالية وتحتاج حجزًا.
questions.explanation_en: Fine dining is expensive and needs a reservation.
